events.reason: Official PGV document metadata contains 11,004 all-three-edge English-French-Spanish document triangles. Independently recommended OPUS GlobalVoices v2018q4 XCES files expose stable document and sentence identities; a preregistered 512-document scope yielded 11,919 unique closed three-language all-pair components, so 512 unit identities were reserved without opening raw story text or tokenizer outputs. Confirmation scoring remains blocked on attribution/leakage audit and a frozen method, preprocessing, metric and token-cost protocol.
